Hi all — quick pre-call tech notes so we can hit the ground running on Tue: 

- Egress / endpoints: For typical "isolated but not fully air-gapped" deployments we only need outbound to a small set of Redwood-managed endpoints (for license checks and optional telemetry). If you are fully air-gapped, license/health checks are disabled and we use signed transfer bundles.

- Ports: HTTPS outbound (443) to whitelisted domains when connectivity allowed; otherwise 443 blocked. Internal traffic between frontend / model workers uses TCP 3210–3220 (configurable) and SSH for admin tasks.

- Artifact delivery (air-gapped): recommended options:
  1) Signed tarball over physical media (SCP from a hardened jump host) — we provide verification scripts and checksums (supported).
  2) Staged pull from a controlled bastion (outbound whitelisted briefly) — requires transient egress window and audit logs.
  3) If you have an internal artifact repo (Artifactory/Nexus), we can produce a signed release your team can pull directly.

- Preflight items to have ready (we’ll add to the calendar invite):
  - VLAN/subnet plan for the deployment,
  - Firewall rule examples (NAT vs. no-NAT),
  - On-prem storage available for models (GB),
  - Admin user for install (local account / AD integration),
  - Access to an air-gap test machine if you want us to validate transfer.

I’ll attach our quick air-gap instruction doc ahead of the call.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Applied ML & Infra, Redwood Inference
